overall_vibe: Minimal, playful, creative, and highly professional. White background, generous whitespace, stark typography, combined with hand-drawn elements (spirals, arrows) and micro-interactions to show creativity.

typography.heading_strategy: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) on large headlines. Fluid scaling for hero text. No generic sans-serifs for headings.
typography.body_strategy: Clean, highly legible geometric sans with loose line-height (leading-relaxed) for perfect readability.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style asymmetry for Case Studies, Masonry for Projects.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, completely custom organic paths for SVG lines.

micro_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle -translate-y-2 on cards, shadow-xl. Custom cursor trailing effect (optional) or magnetic buttons.
micro_interactions.scroll_animations: SVG stroke-dashoffset drawing for the process journey line. Staggered fade-up for case studies. Animated arrows in 'Here's How' section.
micro_interactions.general: Smooth scrolling via lenis is mandatory.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), high contrast (bg-slate-900 text-white), slight scale-up on hover.
components.cards: Minimalist borders (1px border-slate-200), white background, generous padding (p-8).
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog for the video popup in Projects section. Glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40).

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: A striking 3-liner paragraph establishing identity. Very large typography (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Emphasizes the role 'Content Strategist'. Includes a recruiter-friendly CTA ('View Resume' or 'Let's Talk').
sections.layout: Left-aligned or gracefully centered. Massive negative space.

sections.name: Here's How
sections.description: Dummy abstract art with moving arrows. Uses framer-motion to animate arrows along an SVG path over a clean, abstract background.
sections.layout: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 to balance text/explanation and the interactive art.

sections.name: Case Studies
sections.description: Three case study cards displaying editorial/mockup placeholders. Outcome-driven text for recruiters. Subtle hover animation to lift the card.

sections.name: Projects
sections.description: Masonry layout of placeholder videos/reels. Center text overlay 'I experiment a lot'. Clicking a video opens a Shadcn popup modal with title, description, and the video player.
sections.layout: CSS Columns or Masonry grid. High visual density compared to other sections.

sections.name: Process
sections.description: Journey-like line traversing the screen (corner to corner). Hand-drawn spirals mark each step. Line draws itself on scroll.
sections.layout: Relative container. Absolute positioning for the SVG path and spiral checkpoints.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Philosophy text on the left, dummy abstract art in the center, hand-drawn LinkedIn/Email links on the right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for the animated SVG line in the Process section (animate stroke-dashoffset).
Use Shadcn Dialog component for the Video popups in the Projects section.
Use Tailwind masonry classes (columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3) for the Projects section layout.
Ensure the Caveat font is loaded from Google Fonts for hand-drawn elements.
Ensure Cabinet Grotesk is used for headings and Manrope for body text.
Use Lucide-react for the hand-drawn spirals (e.g., using a customized icon) or inline SVGs.
Do NOT use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com. Use the exact media URLs provided.
